inputs.checklistItemText: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) proposed within 25 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
inputs.question: On the landscape plan, identify the symbols used to mark individual trees near the overhead electric line. Cross-reference these symbols with the plant legend and plant schedule to determine the specific species and sizes of trees planted in the southwest corner and southeast corner areas near the OHE line. Which trees are shade trees (large) versus ornamental trees (smaller)?
inputs.regionHint: Focus on the south and southeast portions of the property where trees appear closest to the overhead electric line marked as OHE

output.reasoning: The agent is asking for symbol identification, legend cross-reference, and species/size classification—all presence and labeling checks. Although the checklist requirement ultimately requires a 25-foot lateral distance measurement, the agent question is a progressive verification step focused on identifying which trees are large (40+ feet mature height) before any clearance measurement occurs.
